scope.description: Supplemental saved Boston Licensing Board source-notice review; no new litigation or current-status research.
scope.sources: All available saved source text in the current 2024-2026 corpus and acquired prior-2024/2020-2023 corpus. This is a saved-corpus keyword review, not proof of complete historical notice coverage.
scope.independence: Separate from transfer/pledge events, ownership histories, UCC conclusions, and main-action totals. These observations cannot be added to main-action totals as distinct matters.
scope.attribution: Exact license IDs join source notices to roster history. Historical named parties remain separate from current roster holders. Missing IDs are not filled by name inference.
scope.amounts: Dollar amounts are literal notice values, not current balances, loan principal, paid sale prices, or values to sum. Six observations include amounts; Fire & Ice repeats one expressly identified execution.
scope.source_status: Board acknowledgement of a received notice/correspondence is not a reviewed underlying judicial or tax instrument and does not establish current enforceability or priority.
scope.exclusion_rule: Ordinary execution of annual renewals, physical attachments, post-tax storage, occupancy injunctions, and bankruptcy-only notices are not encumbrance observations.

5. The Board deferred the following pending resolution of active litigation, in which a court order has
entered enjoining Defendant Landlord from interfering with Plaintiff Applicant’s use and occupancy of
the property: Dolce Fumo Restaurant Group Corp. d/b/a Rabia’s Dolce Fumo, located at 71-73 Salem
St, Boston, MA 02113 License #: LB-99726 Holder of a Common Victualler 7 Day Wines and Malt
Beverages with Liqueurs License has petitioned to transfer the license and the location - From: Dolce
Fumo Restaurant Group Corp. located at 71-73 Salem St, Boston MA 02113 To: Little Black Dress
LLC dba Little Black Dress Restaurant located at 13-15 West St, Boston, MA 02111. Obi Anosike,
Manager. 2:00 AM closing hour. Premise consists of - 4,160SF total restaurant space with 2 entrances
and 3 exits on 4 levels of space-basement, 1st floor, mezzanine level, and 2nd floor. Basement includes
multiple storage areas in the front, restrooms and kitchen/prep area in the rear. 1st floor includes host
area and lounge/cafe area in the front, restroom and main kitchen in the rear. Mezzanine level includes a
service and storage area (by the stairs) as well as a dining area. 2nd floor includes a large open dining
area as well as additional restrooms. Secondly, has petitioned to remove the following condition from
the license - Malt and Wine with Liqueurs to be served only in conjunction with meals.
